name: Jile
description_en:
Jile is Tata Consultancy Services’ enterprise Agile planning and delivery product. It connects portfolio and program planning with team backlogs, iterations, tests and delivery information. Its scope is broader than a stand-alone task board: the selected Way of Working configures the planning model, work entities and terminology.

For a software-delivery team, the meaningful evaluation is whether a story can retain its context from backlog planning through task execution and review. Edition matters: team planning, integrated test management and enterprise strategy capabilities do not all belong to the same entry package. This profile separates the documented workflow from untested benefits, integration behavior and subscription questions.
description_zh:
Jile 是 Tata Consultancy Services 的企业敏捷规划与交付产品，将项目组合和项目群规划与团队待办、迭代、测试及交付信息关联。它的范围超出独立任务看板：所选 Way of Working 会配置规划模型、工作实体和术语。

对于软件交付团队，有意义的评估是：一条用户故事能否从待办规划到任务执行与复核始终保留背景。版本也很重要，团队规划、集成测试管理和企业策略能力并非都属于入门套餐。本文将文档工作流与未经测试的收益、集成行为和订阅疑问分开。

sections.title_en: Choose the operating model before importing work
sections.title_zh: 导入工作前先选择运作模型
sections.en:
Jile’s Way of Working describes planning levels, entities, terminology and preconfigured apps. Its options include Scrum, Kanban and enterprise/portfolio approaches. A sprint-based product team and a continuous support queue therefore need different model choices even if both display cards.

In an evaluation, list the records the team actually needs, who owns them and how they progress. Start with one delivery team and avoid enabling a multi-level enterprise structure merely because it exists. Template availability is not evidence that the tool enforces every rule of a named framework or that the organization has adopted it successfully.
sections.zh:
Jile 的 Way of Working 涵盖规划层级、实体、术语和预配置应用，可选择 Scrum、Kanban，以及企业／项目组合方式。基于迭代的产品团队与持续处理支持请求的队列，即使都显示卡片，也需要不同模型。

评估时，应列出团队真正需要的记录、负责人和流转方式。从一个交付团队开始，不应仅因为存在多层企业结构就全部启用。提供模板不证明工具强制执行某框架的全部规则，也不证明组织已成功采用该框架。

sections.title_en: Follow a story through one sprint
sections.title_zh: 跟踪一条故事完成一次迭代
sections.en:
For a hypothetical account-recovery improvement, create a backlog feature/story with acceptance criteria and supporting material. Plan it into an iteration against team capacity, break it into development tasks and record work while using the Scrum board. The product page describes tracking impediments and carrying partially completed stories into the next sprint.

Before calling the pilot complete, compare the story’s criteria with the delivered behavior and inspect unfinished tasks. The board’s status is a process record, not evidence that a release passed testing. This is a proposed evaluation path; no sprint or deployment was executed for the profile.
sections.zh:
假设要改进账户恢复流程，可以创建带验收标准和参考资料的待办功能／故事，按团队容量放入一次迭代，再拆为开发任务，并在 Scrum 看板中记录工作。产品页说明可跟踪阻碍，并把部分完成的故事移到下次迭代。

试点判为完成前，应把故事标准与交付行为比对，并检查未完成任务。看板状态是流程记录，不能证明发布已经通过测试。这是建议的评估路径，本档案未实际执行迭代或部署。

sections.title_en: Check the records behind the dashboard
sections.en:
Jile’s Analytics App can build reports from entities with operations such as pivoting and summing. Reports can be public or private and feed configurable dashboards. The release view includes burndown, cumulative flow, dependencies and impediments; sprint views summarize tasks, tests and issues.

A pilot should trace one number back to its selected records and filters. Confirm whether a partially completed story, a changed estimate or an open dependency appears as expected. A chart can organize operational information, but it does not independently establish customer value, forecast accuracy or the absence of release risk.
sections.zh:
Jile 的 Analytics App 可以基于实体创建报告，并进行透视、求和等操作。报告可设为公开或私有，再组成可配置面板。发布视图包括燃尽图、累积流、依赖和阻碍，迭代视图汇总任务、测试和问题。

试点应选一个数字，追溯其记录范围和筛选条件，确认部分完成故事、变更估算或未解决依赖是否按预期出现。图表可以组织运营信息，但不能独立证明客户价值、预测准确，或发布不存在风险。

sections.title_en: Testing and pipeline visibility have edition boundaries
sections.title_zh: 测试和流水线可见性存在版本边界
sections.en:
The product overview describes requirement-to-test traceability, automated-test history and pipeline insights. The edition page places integrated test management and CI/CD pipeline management in Standard, with broader vision/OKR/value-stream functions under Ultimate. Do not infer entitlement from the homepage’s combined product presentation.

For an intended build integration, identify the tool, authentication and expected evidence: which build or test result should link to which story or defect? Those mappings and failure/retry behavior were not verified here. The description of workbenches on cloud or on-premise also does not establish that every Jile module is available as a self-hosted package.
sections.zh:
产品概述描述了需求到测试的追溯、自动化测试历史和流水线洞察。版本页将集成测试管理与 CI/CD 流水线管理放在 Standard，更广的愿景／OKR／价值流功能放在 Ultimate。不能因为官网统一介绍了产品，就推定当前订阅包含全部模块。

如果要接入构建工具，应明确工具名称、身份验证和预期证据，例如哪个构建或测试结果应关联哪条故事或缺陷。本次没有核实具体映射及失败／重试行为。页面描述工作台可在云端或本地运行，也不能确立每个 Jile 模块都提供自托管包。

sections.title_en: A named Free Edition still has renewal conditions
sections.title_zh: 名为 Free Edition 仍有续期条件
sections.en:
The pricing page lists Free at USD 0 for thirty days, up to fifteen users and 5 GB, with contact required for renewal. Team advertises an estimated USD 12.99 per user/month and up to fifty users; Standard and Ultimate require contact. Treat the estimated figure as a snapshot, not a final payable rate.

The separate FAQ mentions twenty complimentary trial licenses and describes Free renewal differently. This conflict prevents confirming a permanent free entitlement or exact trial license count. Confirm the selected edition and renewal terms with Jile before depending on continued access. No payment or subscription was created.
sections.zh:
定价页将 Free 列为零美元、三十天、最多十五位用户和 5 GB，并要求联系续期。Team 宣传估计每用户每月 12.99 美元、最多五十位用户；Standard 和 Ultimate 需联系销售。估计金额只是快照，不是最终可支付费率。

另一个 FAQ 提到二十个免费试用许可证，对 Free 续期也有不同描述。因此，不能确认永久免费权益或精确试用许可证数。依赖持续访问前，应向 Jile 确认所选版本和续期条款。本次没有创建付款或订阅。

sections.title_en: Trial expiry is an operational boundary
sections.en:
Jile documents ten-day Team/Standard trials and no Ultimate trial. Its subscription material describes a thirty-day data-retention period after expiry, while the precise continued-access wording differs between pages. The documentation also states that downgrade paths are not generally available and explicitly excludes an Ultimate downgrade.

Plan an export and subscription decision before the trial ends rather than relying on archive wording as a backup policy. As an editorial judgment, investigate Jile when integrated software planning and delivery traceability are central. A small generic checklist may not justify its model. Actual recovery, data export, permissions, license contract, interface languages and regional purchase access were not tested or fully established.
sections.zh:
Jile 文档列出 Team／Standard 试用十天，Ultimate 不提供试用。订阅资料描述到期后三十天的数据保留期，但不同页面对能否继续访问的措辞不一致。文档也说明通常不提供降级，并明确排除从 Ultimate 降级。

应在试用结束前安排导出和订阅决定，不应把“归档”措辞当作备份政策。从编辑选型判断看，集成软件规划与交付追溯是核心需求时，值得进一步研究 Jile；简单通用清单可能不值得采用这套模型。实际恢复、数据导出、权限、许可合同、界面语言和地区购买访问尚未测试或完全确立。
